The team repeated the measurements with fixed seeds and identical prompt ordering. Amber remained the recall leader, Birch stayed within the accepted quality tolerance, and Cedar's two early-depth failures appeared again. They also noted that weight offload was inappropriate for the small model because transfer overhead dominated. Based only on this document, which configuration became the conservative default, why was Cedar not selected as the default, and what did the team conclude about weight offload?

Copies run asynchronously so request execution can continue while colder blocks move across the host-device boundary.
